title.after: The Hedden–Ording t=2 positive Whitehead double has tau zero and s two

statement.before:
Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. Let $D_+(T_{2,3},2)$ be the positive-clasped Whitehead double of the right-handed trefoil with two full twists in the clasp, using the twist convention of Hedden and Ording. The normalized knot Floer threshold and Rasmussen invariant satisfy
$$\tau(D_+(T_{2,3},2))=0,\qquad s(D_+(T_{2,3},2))=2.$$
statement.after:
Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. Let $D_+(T_{2,3},2)$ be the positive-clasped Whitehead double of the right-handed trefoil with Hedden–Ording twist parameter $t=2$. The normalized knot Floer threshold and Rasmussen invariant satisfy
$$\tau(D_+(T_{2,3},2))=0,\qquad s(D_+(T_{2,3},2))=2.$$
